nodes.name: Zabargad Liveaboard Diving
nodes.description: Zabargad liveaboards offer guests the chance to go diving on a wreck of an old Russian spy ship in just 24m of calm water. Penetrate the engine room and bridge to discover hoards of glassfish. Octopus, squid, eels, rays, turtles, oceanic whitetips, hammerheads and reef sharks can be spotted too.
